description: Voltage is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Voltage " data table details historically measured average voltage for each Grid and Primary circuit for each half-hourly period. Th table gives the following information: Actual voltage 1-6 per network group Nominal voltage per network group For additional information on column definitions, please click the Dataset schema link below. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Operational Data. Its keywords are Voltage, SPD, SPM, SPT. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
